prior_findings.evidence: src/spec_dock/assets/spec_dock/scripts/spec_dock_runtime/domain/issue_planning_candidate.py:158-185 does not enforce distinct sections: for every required concept group, it independently searches all sections and may select the same non-empty section each time. A concrete bypass is one `## Everything` section containing all mandatory concept tokens, subordinate/canonical-authority text, and four correctly framed PlantUML blocks with the required roles; that payload satisfies the current validator although the concepts are not independent sections. The added negative test only removes all `##` headings and therefore does not cover consolidation into one token-complete section.

src/spec_dock/assets/spec_dock/scripts/spec_dock_runtime/application/issue_planning.py:612-665 performs the explicit Candidate reload after successful final preflight, rejects CandidateArchiveRejected before transaction entry, compares every VerifiedIssueCandidate field, recreates the GitBoundOperationBindingV1 for git-bound mode, and invokes transaction_runner only after those checks. The production loader converts unreadable or invalid snapshots to CandidateArchiveRejected, and tests/unit/application/test_issue_planning_apply.py:607-628 verifies that a preflight-time Candidate swap produces operation_binding_mismatch with zero transaction calls.
